# Repository screenshots

Captured from https://pay-whop.onrender.com/ on 12 November 2026, at a 1280 × 720 viewport.

- `demo-overview.jpg`: the public Rails playground and integration example.
- `demo-billing.jpg`: synthetic customer billing records from real Whop sandbox requests and verified webhooks, including marketplace payment and partial/full refund states.
- `demo-simulations.jpg`: separately labelled local invoice/transfer simulations. These records do not prove real API issuance or settlement.

Screenshots contain no API keys, buyer contact details, private checkout URLs or identity documents. Test amounts can include tax. These repository assets are outside the gem's packaged files.
